createPartnerAdmin.title: Create an admin account
createPartnerAdmin.description: Admin accounts are able to generate therapy codes
createPartnerAdmin.successDescription: Partner Admin created! Email them to say they have an account and will need to use the 'Forgot password' flow to choose a password and be able to login for the first time.

updatePartnerAdmin.title: Update partner admin
updatePartnerAdmin.formError: Make sure you have selected a partner user

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Changes apply straight away. A partner's welcome page is live only when the partner is active and its partner and welcome stories are published in Storyblok.
partners.welcomePageLabel: {partner} welcome page (opens in a new tab)
partners.deactivateDescription: This also deactivates its admins and every member's access through it, and takes its welcome page down. Activating it again restores them.
partners.notRefreshed: {partner} updated, but the site couldn't be refreshed, so its welcome page can take up to 4 hours to change.

deleteCypressUsers.title: Delete test accounts
deleteCypressUsers.description: Permanently deletes all automated-test (Cypress) accounts matching a cypress@chayn.co email, including their database records and related data, and their Firebase, Front and Mailchimp profiles. Use this to clear test data that has leaked into an environment.
deleteCypressUsers.warning: This is a hard delete and cannot be undone.
deleteCypressUsers.confirmLabel: I understand this permanently deletes these accounts and all their data.
